evidence.quote: By anchoring all generation tasks to the morphological richness of routine H&E, MUPAD enables coherent cross-modal synthesis spanning transcriptomics, proteomics (e.g., IHC and mIF), tissue preparation protocols, and clinical text (Fig. 1a).

representation_rationale.summary: The authors use H&E as a central bridging representation to support coherent synthesis across molecular, proteomic, tissue-preparation, and clinical-text modalities.

evidence.quote: Directly fusing text, RNA, and image features hurts performance because these modalities carry information at very different scales and semantics.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors argue against directly fusing heterogeneous text, RNA, and image features because their scales and semantics differ.

evidence.quote: This design lets the network dedicate separate parameters to each modality, preserving their unique biological characteristics while enabling flexible any-modality conditioning.

representation_rationale.summary: Separate modality-specific attention streams are intended to preserve modality-specific biological characteristics while allowing flexible conditioning.

evidence.quote: Raw RNA-seq counts were normalized to TPM, filtered to remove housekeeping and mitochondrial genes, and compressed into 331 pathway-level enrichment scores using established pan-cancer gene signatures 61 , yielding biologically interpretable conditioning inputs.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors use pathway-level enrichment scores as biologically interpretable RNA conditioning inputs.

evidence.quote: both data sources are compressed into pathway-level scores using the same gene-set signatures, presenting the model with a consistent conditioning format across both stages.

representation_rationale.summary: The shared pathway-score format gives bulk RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics a consistent conditioning interface.

evidence.quote: the CNN spatial alignment preserves the fine-grained histological texture information critical for high-fidelity pathology image synthesis, while the CLS token denoising loss anchors the global semantic content of intermediate noisy representations to the clean-image manifold.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors motivate CNN spatial alignment and CLS denoising as preserving fine-grained texture while maintaining global semantic consistency.

evidence.quote: REPA does not confer a meaningful advantage over the naive SiT baseline in our setting, suggesting that MLP-based global alignment is insufficient for capturing the fine-grained spatial structure of histological images.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors report that MLP-based global alignment is insufficient for fine-grained histological spatial structure in their setting.
